algorithm: DexWM: a deterministic latent-space (DINOv2) world model with a CDiT-based predictor conditioned on MANO fingertip-keypoint-difference actions, trained with a state-prediction loss plus an auxiliary hand-consistency heatmap loss; controlled via CEM/MPC planning in latent space
success_criterion: reach/place: Euclidean distance threshold; grasp: object-robot contact
headline_metric: RoboCasa sim success rate (50 trials/task) and real-robot grasping success (12 trials) vs. Diffusion Policy
headline_value: RoboCasa: DexWM Reach 72%, Place 28%, Grasp 58% vs. Diffusion Policy Reach 16%, Place 8%, Grasp 0% (Table 4); real robot grasping: DexWM 83% (10/12) vs. Diffusion Policy 0%
human_data: EgoDex (829 hours egocentric human video with hand+pose annotations) plus DROID (parallel-jaw-gripper robot data), used only for world-model pretraining, not action-labeled demonstrations for a policy
note_gaps: Table 3's open-loop rollout numbers are referenced but the table itself was not captured in this excerpt; Sec. 4.2/4.3 ablation table content beyond Table 1 was not fully captured in this pass
retargeting_objective: no explicit robot retargeting network; both human hands (MANO 21-keypoint) and robot end-effectors (Allegro fingertips via forward kinematics; parallel-jaw grippers approximated with dummy circular keypoints) are mapped into the same fingertip-keypoint-difference action representation, with the missing pinky filled by reusing the ring-finger-equivalent Allegro keypoints
